answer: Picture reward as a flat mesa, not a peak you can multiply: each epoch mints one fixed pool, split by attestations from established non-kin peers. A gale of fresh sybil keys cannot inflate it — they only subdivide their own slice, and kinship-weighting drives self-vouching inside an invite cluster toward zero. Honest standing climbs a probation terrace: it accrues only as independent graders seal your output across many separate epochs, so raw identity count buys nothing without real, separately-verified labor.
